content:
Nuevo Laredo’s municipal government is offering established local businesses in-kind support worth up to 200,000 pesos to modernize and grow, under a program announced this week by Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal.

The program, called “MyPime Avanza: Juntos Emprendemos, Negocios que Transforman” (Together We Undertake, Businesses that Transform), targets micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises in the city, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo. Beneficiaries can receive between 30,000 and 200,000 pesos each, delivered exclusively in kind — meaning equipment and goods rather than cash — to be put toward minor machinery, tools, technological equipment, commercial equipment, and other goods that improve how the business operates.

Canturosas Villarreal said the program is a tool for formally established businesses to strengthen their operating capacity, incorporate equipment, and improve their competitiveness, as part of a broader economic development strategy. The mayor urged local entrepreneurs to register early so more businesses can access the benefits.

To qualify, applicants must be individuals or companies with businesses formally established and operating in Nuevo Laredo, registered with Mexico’s tax authority (SAT), and with at least six months of verifiable economic activity. Applications are evaluated on criteria including the business’s tax standing, longevity, investment proposal, and growth plan, according to the report.

The application window closes Oct. 27, 2026. Registration is available online at the program portal, and applicants must also complete the accompaniment plan or enroll in the training activities of the city’s “Hecho en Nuevo Laredo” program.

Sources: El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, Oct. 21, 2026.

title: Nuevo Laredo offers local businesses up to 200,000 pesos in equipment support through 'MyPime Avanza' — deadline Oct. 27
